messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch (Friday–Sunday) that includes at least one statutory holiday.  The dates shown are the *actual* holiday dates; the “observed” dates (when the holiday falls on a weekend) are also noted where relevant.

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long Weekend Dates |
|---|---------|-------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Observed Mon Jan 2 | **Fri Dec 30 – Sun Jan 1** |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | **Mon, Feb 20** | — | **Fri Feb 17 – Sun Feb 19** |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Fri, Apr 7** | — | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Mon, May 22** | — | **Fri May 19 – Sun May 21** |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Sat, Jul 1** | Observed Mon Jul 3 | **Fri Jun 30 – Sun Jul 2** |
| 6 | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | **Mon, Aug 7** | — | **Fri Aug 4 – Sun Aug 6** |
| 7 | Labour Day | **Mon, Sep 4** | — | **Fri Sep 1 – Sun Sep 3** |
| 8 | Thanksgiving | **Mon, Oct 9** | — | **Fri Oct 6 – Sun Oct 8** |

### Notes & Variations

| Province/Region | Additional Long Weekend(s) in 2023 |
|------------------|-----------------------------------|
| British Columbia | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mon Mar 27) – not a statutory holiday but widely observed. |
| Alberta | **St. Andrew’s Day** (Mon Mar 27) – not a statutory holiday. |
| Quebec | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** (Mon June 24) – not a statutory holiday. |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **St. John’s Day** (Mon Jun 26) – not a statutory holiday. |
| Yukon | **Yukon Day** (Mon Aug 7) – same as Civic Holiday. |
| Northwest Territories | **NWT Day** (Mon Aug 7) – same as Civic Holiday. |
| Nunavut | **Nunavut Day** (Mon Aug 7) – same as Civic Holiday. |

> **Reminder:** Some provinces have additional provincial holidays that may create extra long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on Feb 20, St. Patrick’s Day in BC on Mar 27, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll want to pull the full holiday schedule for each jurisdiction.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of statutory holidays per province, or if you need the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) for integration into your holiday‑planning app.
